decisions.name: Leatherwood Branch Park Access
decisions.rationale: The KDFWR coordinate exactly matches the shared route point. KDFWR labels the site carry-down only with no constructed ramp and says paddlers walk equipment a short distance from parking to the creek; no exact wet-edge coordinate is published.

postCorrectionAudit.severity: review for all 3 as authoritative access-area anchors

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if KDFWR publishes a ramp-toe coordinate or current high-resolution imagery supports a precise landing point.

decisions.name: Davis Park, Conway
decisions.rationale: The UNH GRANIT public-water inventory provides a Town of Conway Davis Park point on the Saco with shorebank access. The Town identifies a canoe launch, but the inventory does not give a surveyed wet-edge coordinate.

postCorrectionAudit.severity: review for all 3 as authoritative access-area anchors

decisions.reopenWhen: Refine the point if Conway supplies a surveyed canoe-launch coordinate or imagery clearly identifies the public water-entry edge.
